result: RELEASED 2026-05-20. Tooling implemented + live-verified end-to-end. db:dev:up brought up inflx-dev-pg (postgres:16-alpine @ localhost:5433, persistent volume inflx-dev-pgdata). db:dev:init applied ALL 54 migrations (001..055) 0-error against inflx_dev; 56 tables + 1 view (v_searchable_creators present) — mirrors prod schema exactly. dev-doctor returned 4 greens (Docker daemon, container UP, Postgres conn, DB schema) + 2 EXPECTED reds against the founder's current prod-pointing backend/.env (DATABASE_URL → Supabase pooler + missing ONESIGNAL_MOCK) — these are the no-silent-green proof points; symmetric logic means both flip green when the founder swaps backend/.env per LOCAL.md.
